severityDecision: CONFIRMED-LOW (regression floor honoured; priority raised, severity deliberately NOT inflated)
severityRationale:
Severity CONFIRMED LOW. Triage priority RAISED TO 1 - the highest in the run. These are different axes and the distinction is deliberate.

REGRESSION FLOOR. A finding that reappears after remediation inherits AT LEAST its prior severity. Ledger eda17642828a6dd3 (label L-01, entryPoint `dev`) is stored at severity `low`, status `fix-pending` - confirmed by this classifier directly against ledger.json. The floor is therefore Low, and Low is honoured.

WHY NOT RAISED ABOVE THE FLOOR. The re-raised defect is the same one as before: the local rehearsal never exercises the cutover mechanics (setDispatcher / replaceDispatcher / pull / NFT-mint all back to zero executions). The mainnet ordering hazard it mirrors is genuinely severe and genuinely silent in the wrong direction - the project's own runbook states the reverse order 'LEAKS VALUE SILENTLY' - but that hazard lives in the mainnet script, which encodes the correct per-index order and asserts bidirectional wiring in Phase 7. Nothing about this deletion makes the mainnet order wrong; it removes a local proof that it is right. Same reasoning as CAND-01: assurance lost, not availability impacted. Raising it to Medium would be inflating severity to express priority, which this classifier is directed not to do and which C4 rejects as overstatement.

WHY PRIORITY 1. Per CLAUDE.md a regression on a fix-pending entry ranks immediately below an INCOMPLETE FIX in triage priority. This run contains no incomplete fix, so this is the top item. The specific danger is that run-29 recorded a PROPOSE-FIXED on this entry (execution-proved, never applied by a human) on the strength of story-079's _rehearseDispatcherSwap, and e6eded0 DELETES that helper - so the proposed fix no longer exists in the tree. A pipeline that carried run-29's standing recommendation forward would close a live finding on the strength of code that has been removed. That is the single most dangerous outcome available in this run, and it is a bookkeeping failure, not a severity failure - hence priority, not label.

The sanitizer's binding instructions are ENDORSED and restated: status MUST remain `fix-pending` (never open, never fixed, never 'regression' as a status); run-29's propose-fixed MUST be withdrawn and the withdrawal recorded in the note; the path trap is real (unprefixed this mints 328eb226708d2390 and silently re-files L-01 as a brand-new finding) so finding-manager MUST normalise to lib/phoenix-phase-2-staging/... before upsert. The collateralObservation is also ENDORSED: the four open run-27 entries anchored on the deleted helper (6af1ae30ed82, 19e2e0c2d6a3, 9ee101a0cc41, 9067d8a232b5) MUST NOT be auto-flipped to `fixed` - closing-by-deletion would ratify the very reversal this finding reports, and all four return the instant the rehearsal is restored. Manual review, human /ledger decision.
